definitions.name: S0C.SUM
definitions.note: Sum of a Vector of numbers; an empty Vector sums to 0.

definitions.name: S0C.ORDERS
definitions.note: Parse the JSON String and answer its orders Vector.

definitions.name: S0C.REVENUE
definitions.body: [ 'Q' BIND 0 Q 'qty' GET Q 'price' GET MUL Q 'price' GET NIL? SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Total of qty times price over a Vector of orders; an order without a price contributes 0.

definitions.name: S0C.QTY_BY_SKU
definitions.body: 'O' BIND O [ 'sku' GET ] MAP O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ S0C.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Record from sku to summed qty over a Vector of orders, skus in first-appearance order.

definitions.name: S0C.ARGMAX_FIRST
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Key of a Record holding the largest value; ties go to the key that comes first.

definitions.name: S0C.WORDS
definitions.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ 'Q' BIND Q '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Split a String on spaces and drop the empty pieces, giving its words in order.

definitions.name: S0C.CAPWORD
definitions.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER W CHARS 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Capitalise one word: first letter upper case, the rest lower case.

solutions.sensor.present_mean: 'R' BIND R [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND P S0C.SUM P LENGTH DIV
solutions.sensor.filled: 'R' BIND R R [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A E E NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: 'R' BIND 1 0 R [ NIL? ] MAP SELECT 'G' BIND [ 0 ] G CONCAT G LENGTH TAKE 'GP' BIND G S0C.SUM G GP MUL S0C.SUM SUB
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: 'R' BIND R 0 [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 E NIL? SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'R' BIND R 1 DROP R R LENGTH 1 SUB TAKE DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'R' BIND R [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND P 1 DROP P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND R M DIV
solutions.orders.unpriced: S0C.ORDERS [ 'Q' BIND Q 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: S0C.ORDERS [ 'Q' BIND Q 'tags' GET NIL? NOT ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.messy.normalize: LOWER S0C.WORDS [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
solutions.messy.title: S0C.WORDS [ S0C.CAPWORD ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: LOWER S0C.WORDS UNIQUE SORT [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
